subject: Request: align demo to CTO's travel window
messages:
From: Claire Novak <claire.novak@skylinehealth.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Demo next week — possible CTO attendance?

Hi Priyom / Monica —

Thanks again for walking us through the initial docs last week. Our team is excited to see Redwood running against our clinical summarization workload. Our CTO, Daniel Park, may be able to join the live demo but his travel schedule is tight next week. He said he can join for a 45-minute slot on Thursday 3 Sep between 11:00–12:00 PDT, but that window is firm because he's in transit that afternoon.

Could you let us know if you can shift the demo into that slot? If not, we can run the demo without him and record a short follow-up briefing.

I've attached a one-page summary of our evaluation goals (Skyline-MAP-v2.pdf) for context.

Best,
Claire
Claire Novak
Head of Product Operations | Skyline Health
claire.novak@skylinehealth.com
Attachment: Skyline-MAP-v2.pdf

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Novak <claire.novak@skylinehealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo next week — possible CTO attendance?

Claire —

Thanks for the heads up and for the summary — that's helpful. We can definitely prioritize aligning with Daniel's window. Monica and I will swap the agenda to a tighter 40–45 minute run: 20 minutes demo (focused on throughput & latency for clinical summaries), 10 minutes for the feature highlights relevant to extraction/PHI handling, and 10–15 minutes for CTO-level Q&A and next steps.

Markus — can you lead the latency/scale portion and prepare a 2-slide appendix on quantization/serving modes in case Daniel asks about deployment options? Also, please flag any pre-demo artifacts you'd like Claire's team to confirm (sample prompt sets, dataset size).

Claire — if 11:00–11:45 or 11:15–12:00 PDT on 3 Sep works, drop the invite and we'll accept. If the CTO needs a hard start at 11:00, we can push to 11:00–11:45.

I'll also plan to record the session and share the recording + the condensed deck afterward.

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Claire Novak <claire.novak@skylinehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo next week — possible CTO attendance?

Sounds good — I'll condense the SE portion. Proposed tweaks:
- Start 11:00 PDT sharp so Daniel can jump in during his travel window.
- I will do a 12-minute deep-dive on serving economics (cost per 1k tokens for a 1k->4k context), followed by a 6–8 minute look at the quantization/latency tradeoffs.
- We'll keep a short breakout at the end for security/compliance (Monica — can you be ready for SOC/S3/KMS questions?).

Claire — quick ask: since this is a tight slot, can you confirm (1) whether Daniel prefers a condensed slide deck (we can reduce to 6 slides + appendix) and (2) if he needs a dial-in-only option or can join via Google Meet? If you send the calendar invite I'll accept and mark the event as 'recording on'.

For reference I'm attaching the condensed deck stub we'll use (see attachment stub below). If you prefer we can also forward a short pre-read to Daniel this afternoon.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
Attachment: (condensed-deck-stub.pdf)

From: Claire Novak <claire.novak@skylinehealth.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo next week — possible CTO attendance?

Perfect — Daniel confirmed and asked that we run 11:00–11:45 PDT on Thu 3 Sep. I've created the calendar invite (link below) and attached the one-pager again. Daniel will join via Google Meet (he's on the road but has a reliable connection).

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=skyline-demo-20260903
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/skyline-health/deal/4827

See you Thursday — please keep the CTO portion tight and call out the deployment and data-protection bullets early so he can jump out if needed. We'll expect a recording for anyone who cannot make it.

Best,
Claire
Claire Novak
Head of Product Operations | Skyline Health
claire.novak@skylinehealth.com
Attachment: Skyline-MAP-v2.pdf
